entities.name: Fang Bin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fang Bin is a Chinese businessman, citizen journalist and whistleblower who used YouTube and WeChat to broadcast images of Wuhan during the COVID-19 pandemic. He was arrested several times between February 1 and 9, 2020.
